opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, have a meaningful connection to Scotland, are enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish higher education institution, and are not fully covered by public funding (e.g., SAAS).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,820 per year to cover undergraduate tuition fees for eligible low‑income Scottish students who cannot obtain sufficient public funding.
